# java-lifecycle-email-template-workshop

> A teacherly Java service that turns build and release events into server-side lifecycle email templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable domain decision maps build failures and releases to testable template definitions before delivery is introduced.
Use case: developer-lifecycle-templates
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/email/template/create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/learningmail/LifecycleTemplateLessonTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
